hero.name: Nguyễn Thanh Hà Huy
hero.role: Frontend Developer building fast, accessible interfaces with React & Next.js.
hero.pitch: 4+ years shipping production web apps in React and Next.js for clients across Canada, France, the Netherlands and Vietnam. Comfortable across both Next.js routers, TypeScript and modern state management — from pixel-accurate Figma builds to Core Web Vitals and technical SEO.

about.title: Background & approach
about.intro: Coming from an Electronics & Telecommunications Engineering background, I pivoted early and have spent over 4 years specializing in frontend development. Building web apps for partners at home and abroad has shaped a way of working built around 3 focus areas:

highlights.title: Interface & Design Systems
highlights.description: Going beyond turning Figma designs into pixel-perfect interfaces, I focus on UI/UX thinking, actively contribute to design systems, and write interactive documentation with Storybook to keep things consistent and easy to scale. I also use Jest and React Testing Library to test components and keep the system running reliably.

highlights.title: Performance & Optimization
highlights.description: To me, speed isn't an afterthought bolted on at the end of a project. Hitting strong Core Web Vitals scores, applying lazy loading, code splitting and technical SEO are non-negotiable standards in every line of code, for the smoothest experience possible.

highlights.title: Code Quality & Transparency
highlights.description: Peer code review is a core part of the culture, not a box-ticking formality — it keeps conventions consistent and minimizes risk. Alongside that, I actively bring AI agent tools into the development workflow to automate work, increase accuracy, and speed up delivery.
